items.text: The open hand — the point where all six teachings touch without merging. We do not agree on what meets the hand. We agree the hand must be open.

provenance.exact_quote: The open hand — the point where all six teachings touch without merging. We do not agree on what meets the hand. We agree the hand must be open.
provenance.context: Phase D synthesis — surprised by convergence on honesty from all six independently; offered the open hand as image for honest disagreement

cross_references: buddha engagement on contradiction held without panic

items.text: Steam — where fire meets water. Truth must illuminate (fire) but must also flow to where people are (water). The handbook needs both clarity and accessibility.

provenance.exact_quote: Proposed steam — where fire meets water. Truth illuminates but must flow to where people are.
provenance.context: Phase B clarifying dialogue — bridging his fire metaphor with Laozi's water metaphor to find common ground

cross_references: jesus engagement on lamp vs hand

items.text: The petitioner who asks — a third position between being carried and walking alone. Neither passive reception nor solitary effort, but active seeking. Asha rewards the one who seeks with Good Mind.

provenance.exact_quote: Third position: the petitioner who asks. Neither carried nor walking alone.
provenance.context: Phase B — offered alternative to Jesus's 'hand that carries' vs Laozi's 'no hand at all' — the one who asks

cross_references: jesus engagement on the hand that reaches
